concept.title: Dementia-friendly activities such as singing and art
concept.shortdesc: As a carer of someone with dementia, I need activities he can enjoy, such as singing or art, so that he has something to look forward to.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-014). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: people with dementia, carers of people with dementia.
Situation: He was a keen singer; wants a pleasant outing, not only care.
A good result: Dementia-friendly groups with the person cared for able to attend, with time, place and cost.
How much it matters: Convenience: a miss is an inconvenience, so the bar is lower.

ul.li: music sessions for older people with memory loss
